# laravelforge_provider (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge server provider (e.g. DigitalOcean, AWS, Hetzner) from the global catalog by ID. Providers are global, not scoped to an organization.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server provider.

### Read-Only

- `currency` (String) Currency code the provider bills in (e.g. `USD`).
- `currency_symbol` (String) Currency symbol for the billing currency (e.g. `$`).
- `default_region_code` (String) Default region code for the provider, if any.
- `default_size_code` (String) Default server size code for the provider, if any.
- `name` (String) Human-readable provider name.
- `simple_name` (String) Short display name for the provider, if exposed.
- `slug` (String) Provider slug used when provisioning (e.g. `ocean2`, `aws`).
